verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a developer tool that captures agent traces and injects user-written corrections into prompts when routing conditions match. Background automation is a fair question for agent tooling, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no user-configured automations, scheduled jobs, or background tasks that run on their own. Auto-applied correction routing and background trace capture are adjacent features that only fire inside the customer's own agent runs, so they do not count toward this story.
